snippet.title: Rochinko -  Gameplay
snippet.description:
2 minutes gameplay video.

Wishlist now on PC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/39...

Rochinko is a dark fantasy pachinko-roguelike where you launch arcane orbs into boards swarming with monsters and treasure, watching them ricochet through pegs in a cascade of destruction and gold. Upgrade your gear, master unique ball powers, and survive through 100 levels to save the Shadowlands.
